title: Not much difference with the previous version
content: The only difference of this version with the previous one is the A12 bionic chip. That's it. When iPad Air has evolved with a large step forward, the base model is still going around in circles. The improvement in speed is hardly detectable, if you only use this iPad to watch YouTube, web browsing, play music, etc. Considering the A10 Fusion chip in the previous model is already very powerful, you don't need A12 bionic at all for these tasks. If you want to create videos, make some cool illustrations with Procreate, go for iPad Air. So my suggestion is, buy the previous version if you only need it for some casual tasks. And buy iPad Air or even Pro if you want to do some creative works. Pros: - It's from Apple? Cons: - Not much difference with previous model - No USB-C connection - No multi-user option
